hooks.name: CSP and data-source review
hooks.description: After any edit to index.html, ask the agent to re-check the security contract and document new endpoints before moving on.

action.prompt: You have just edited index.html. Before continuing, verify the change preserves the single-file contract: (1) no external script, style, font, iframe or remote image was introduced; (2) every new network endpoint is HTTPS, CORS-enabled in a browser, and listed in .kiro/steering/data-sources.md and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md; (3) remote strings still go through esc() before HTML insertion; (4) node scripts/check-app.js passes. If any check fails, fix it or explain the failure instead of ignoring it.
